evidence.detail: load_achievements calls a.detail(p, season_id) for every achievement unconditionally when with_detail=True — 18 of 23 achievements have detail_sql and thus trigger deck.load_decks()
template only renders {{#detail}} inside {{#legend}} — detail is never shown for unearned achievements, so loading it is wasted work
prepare_decks already guards 'if achievement.detail is not None' so skipping detail for unearned achievements is safe

triage.fix_sketch: In decksite/data/achievements.py line 27 change `if with_detail:` block to `if with_detail and desc.legend:` so detail is only loaded for achievements the person has earned. One-word addition; eliminates up to 18 deck.load_decks() calls for players who have earned few achievements.
triage.notes: For players with no achievements the page currently executes 18 deck queries and discards all results; after the fix it executes 0. For players who have earned many achievements, savings are proportional to unearned count.
